title: Cops Mistake Mass Killer for Prankster

transcript.text: My son, murdered them all. He was locked up for 20 years. You could go to the address and verify it, but I want you to handcuff me first. I got a call from two cousins. My son, murder them all. I don't know. I just got here, and I don't trust him. Do you know the cousin? Does he have mental disorders? What's up? Who's the guy that called? My son, yes, he was locked up for 20 years. Yes, he's got meditations. What was he locked up for? All kinds of violations. I wasn't notified of anyone being inside. Cleveland police! Oh, shit. Cleetton police! Somebody's on the bed. Someone's moving too. Oh, yeah, it's real. Get EMS rolling. You got one female on the ground.
